excerpt: The ESM migration is on. Sindre Sorhus committed to ESM-only and dragged a thousand packages with him; node-fetch@3 followed this summer. Your dependency tree is now a mix of CommonJS and ES Modules, and there's a failure mode hiding in that mix. Node's docs name it the dual package hazard. Most people meet it as a cryptic instanceof bug.
title: The dual package hazard
categories: cannot use from another module or realm
